unresolvedReferences.description: Lang Youfu's flight from Luzhou is undated (before 883).
The Yangzhou struggle with Bi Shiduo, Qin Yan and Sun Ru is not dated in the text (Guangqi 3, 887, inferred).
An Renyi's capture and execution at Guangling is not dated in this chunk (rebellion c. 903).
Zhu Yanshou is mentioned without a date in this chunk.
Murder of Zhu Yanshou dated only by Tian Run and An Renyi's rebellions (c. 903).
The Liuyang defeat of Liu Cun and Chen Zhixin is dated only after the Kaiping change (907-908).
Yang Pu's imperial declaration is undated here.
The sixth-month revolt of Wei Quanfeng is dated only by sequence after 908 (909 inferred).
Zhao Huang is mentioned only in retrospect, undated.
Xu Zhixun's abuse of Longyan and the Zhu Jin affair are dated by sequence to 918 (Tianyou 15).
Yang Pu's death is given only as the twelfth month after the 937 abdication; the year (937 vs. 938) is not stated.
Lian, Prince of Jiangdu, invested crown prince in Dahe 2 (930), has no person-name candidate and was not extracted.
Jingsui (second son of Zhigao) has no name candidate and was not extracted.
Xu Wen's porridge relief during the campaign against Zhao Huang is undated.
Liu Xin's dice oath at Jinling falls between 918 and 925, undated.
Cai Chou's rebellion at Luzhou is undated here.
Liu Xin's flight to Sun Ru is undated (before 892).
